page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred. Lines run from the top of the page to the bottom. Below them is a woodcut of a fish. Show-through from the reverse, mirrored, is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is a title page with a woodcut of a fish below the text (an engraving, not transcribed). The top and centre lines are set in large capitals and are heavily faded. Their letters, and the bottom imprint with place and date, could not be read with confidence and are marked illegible. The line "A NIMALIVM" is printed with V for the vowel and is given as ANIMALIUM in its own line per the vowel rule; the scan shows it as "A NIMALIVM", so check this line. The strongest reading is "IN MARI ET DVLCI" (in the sea and in fresh water). The name "Rondeletii" is a tentative reading and is marked [?]. Show-through text from the reverse page is mirrored and has been omitted.
